fields.description: The gateway in the payments app that collects this. Filled in by the system from what the payments app offers, and not typed here.
fields.label: Gateway

fields.description: What an applicant is shown. Change it to say what your society calls this way of paying.
fields.label: Shown As

fields.description: Untick to stop offering this way of paying. A method already used by an outstanding payment keeps working; this only decides what a new applicant is offered.
fields.label: Offered

fields.description: Anything the applicant needs to be told before they choose this — an account number, an office to pay at, what happens next. Shown under the option.
fields.label: What to tell the applicant
